## Requirements

(From the contract — deliverables 1–5.)

1. `hir-documents` arm: HIR/1 documents → validate verdict → canonical
   bytes → seal digest; inputs/expected/answers slots; CHECKER sections in
   the existing arms' literal form, append-only.
2. Ledger-corpus extension cases: additional transcript/WAL scenarios
   (`ledger-scenarios` arm), same slots + CHECKER sections.
3. Machinery: exporter emits, `self_check` replays, `verify` compares the
   new arms.
4. `bundle.json` regenerated — `generated_by: E1`, `arms[]` extended,
   `files` pins every member, `pending_cells[]` honest (new arms' E3 cells
   pending until R4.4a; E2 cells record the e2 tree cannot answer them).
5. E1 self-check green over the enlarged set; numbers recorded.
6. Dated notes on DF-S1.2-2 + DF-S1.5-3 (rows stay OPEN).

## Acceptance criteria

- New arm(s) committed with CHECKER sections; `self_check` green over all
  arms (deterministic · fixture-verified).
- `bundle.json` regenerated, `check-drift.sh`/xcheck drift legs clean,
  `files` pins every new member (deterministic · engineered).
- `verify` handles the new arms — a corrupted foreign answer for a
  new-arm case fails `verify` by name (deterministic · engineered).
- DF-S1.2-2 / DF-S1.5-3 dated notes appended (deterministic · engineered).
- Universal phase-gate AC (agentic).
